notes.title: Patch 1.03 Details
notes.content:
Shantae and the Pirate's Curse is back with a brand new update adding additional language support!

[h1]Patch 1.03 - New Features[/h1]

[list][*]Language Support - We've added French, Italian, German, and Spanish. New languages can be set by accessing the title's "Properties" menu in the Steam Library and navigating to the "Language" tab.
[/list]

- WayForward

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Details
notes.content:
Shantae and the Pirate's Curse is back with a brand new update! Thanks for all of your feedback! As requested we've added: 

[h1]Patch 1.02 - New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Keyboard Configuration - We've added support for customizing the keyboard controls!
    [*]Sound Sliders - We've added both a MUSIC and SFX Slider allowing for in-game volume adjustments.
[/list]

- WayForward

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Details
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Shantae and the Pirate's Curse! This new update includes the following: 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed crashes with an error relating to "Bad Allocation".
    [*]Fixed a crash that prompted a "ProfileBar.cpp" error.
    [*]Fixed a low repro random crash that could occur when moving when transitioning between rooms. 
    [*]Adjusted resolution saving settings (now if you ALT+ENT to swap between fullscreen or windowed, the setting will save).
    [*]Fixed an issue where Avast would detect the title as malware and delete the EXE.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There is a performance issue when allowing a user to view your broadcast through Steam. This issue should be resolved by Valve in an upcoming Steam Client update.
[/list]
